contract: GET /feed/:slug/cover*. Stream the cover image of a feed by slug without authentication, using the persisted coverPath and Content-Type image/<extension>. An extensionless path and a query string (the ?ts= cache buster the XML advertises) serve the same file. An unknown slug or a feed whose coverPath is NULL answers 404; no other file can be read through the route.
exceptions: force is not applicable: no feed route has a force, hard or override mode; a feed is refreshed implicitly when its entity is newer than entityUpdatedAt.
Content-Length is not asserted because upstream streams the file (Transfer-Encoding chunked); the body length is asserted instead.
Cache-Control/ETag are not asserted: the route sets none, so they are not a client-visible contract of this route.
A cover file that disappears between the row read and the stream is handled by an error handler that answers 404 (RssFeedManager.js:256-262); that race is not reproducible deterministically.

invariants.contract: GET /feed/:slug/cover.jpg with no token answers 200 Content-Type image/jpg with the exact bytes of the file named by the persisted coverPath (Content-Length is not set because the file is streamed). The extensionless URL the web client builds (/feed/:slug/cover) and the XML imageURL with its ?ts=<entityUpdatedAt> query serve the identical bytes, and repeated reads are identical.

An unknown slug and an existing feed whose persisted coverPath is NULL both answer 404 and stream no bytes, so the slug capability cannot be used to read an arbitrary file. After a refresh the published imageURL's ?ts= equals the new entityUpdatedAt while the cover bytes and coverPath stay unchanged. If the cover file disappeared after the row was read the stream error answers 404, not a 500 or a partial image.
